title_candidates: They named this robot 'Super Athlete' for a reason

What the world's most athletic robot looks like in action
caption:
Unitree's newest robot moves like a trained human athlete, and 5 million people couldn't stop watching.

The AS2-W is built to copy the balance, speed, and agility of a real person. Unitree, the same company behind some of the most viral robot clips ever, calls this one their 'Super Athlete.' Watching it move, you'll understand why the name fits.
